description: This file defines a Fragment named LogFragment that creates a user interface component containing a custom LogView within a ScrollView. It handles view inflation, layout setup, and manages text change events to auto-scroll the log output.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that displays a log view inside a scrollable container, handles view creation and text change events for auto-scrolling.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Creates and sets up the ScrollView and LogView, configuring layout parameters, styles, and padding.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Lifecycle method that inflates views, attaches a text change listener to auto-scroll on new log entries, and returns the root view.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Provides access to the internal LogView instance.
